en.title: g in get / give (/g/)
en.summary: The letter g represents the voiced velar plosive sound /g/ as in the words get and give.

sections.title: The sound
paragraphs: These letters are called /ge/, /gi/. They make the sound /ɡʲ/, as in the word (gheață) /ˈɡe̯at͡sə/, which means ice. This group makes only one sound in Romanian.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Press the back of your tongue against the roof of your mouth. Keep the middle of your tongue high and close to the roof. Release the air suddenly with your voice. Touch your throat to feel your vocal cords buzz.

sections.title: Spelling rules
paragraphs: The letters ghe or ghi always make the sound /ɡʲ/. You hear this sound before e or i, as in the word (ghid) /ɡid/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not say the sound like the soft sound in the English word gem. It is a hard sound, like the g in geese. Always keep the sound fully voiced and sharp.
